listed_quote.quote: Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (NYSE: TTP), Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NYSE: NDP)

announcement.quote: Tortoise announced today that following a strategic review of the funds, the Board of Directors has approved a proposal to merge Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NDP) with and into Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (TTP).

deals.notes: The special meeting of April 7, 2021 was to be convened and adjourned to June 4, 2021 (DEFA14A 2021-04-06). The 2022 annual meeting filings (2022-06-24, 2022-08-05) still list Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NDP) as a separate company alongside TTP, but the excerpts never state whether the merger was terminated, failed or completed.

problems: Outcome not stated in the excerpts; the DEF 14A of 2021-05-25 and the 2022 DEF 14A are shown only as headers.
